short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1207 recent saved-signal files and 324 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @jeanpiconsuegra: Been really into using every single color imaginable in my design work lately and @drizzypostingls: Fucking godly soundtrack too i think i fell in love with this game, plus 7 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Dither Boy - Studio AAA Advanced Image Dithering App.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-29. Use game-space surface with browserless media shrine; make Square anchor-image pressure translated into several nearly square dither tiles that do not align perfectly with the landscape canvas. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central torn white pixel island, upper-left halftone panel, and upper-right blue orb with vertical slit.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
